//: Everything in renderer/ is an ES module. The browser knows that from <script type="module">, but Node does not — it reads the nearest package.json, and the app's own has no "type" because main.js is CommonJS. Without this file, main.js's dynamic import() of the provider table fails with `Unexpected token 'export'` and the whole app boots into a black window with no error anywhere. Node 22 happens to sniff the syntax and recover, which is why the tests passed while the app did not.
